cognitive_services.feature_id: Azure Computer Vision Text Extraction Engine
cognitive_services.downstream_handler: Passes raw text maps into GPT models for automated normalization and structuring

cognitive_services.purpose: Consumes natural text input and structures symptom matrices into clear markdown diagnostic and dosage recommendation tables

cognitive_services.cognitive_client: Azure AI Document Intelligence (prebuilt ID model, async analyze + poll via httpx, env: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT / AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY)
cognitive_services.downstream_handler: Extracted INE/ID fields are surfaced as editable pre-filled inputs on the frontend id-summary confirmation step; Tesseract.js (src/utils/idOcr.ts) is a client-side fallback OCR path, not backend-orchestrated

cognitive_services.orchestrator: N/A — runs entirely on-device via @vladmandic/face-api (src/utils/faceLiveness.ts, src/components/FaceLivenessCapture.tsx)
cognitive_services.purpose: 4-direction challenge (left/right/up/down) + blink detection with CONSISTENCY_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD=0.95 / MATCH_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD=0.6 descriptor comparison against the captured ID selfie. Backend only receives the final pass/fail + confidence_score via modules/clientFaceRecognitions.py — it does not run any recognition itself.
cognitive_services.note: Azure Face API / Face-Liveness-With-Verify was used earlier and has been fully removed from the backend (routes, module, env gating) in favor of this client-side approach — do not reintroduce Azure Face API calls.

cognitive_services.purpose: Compares the signature crop taken from the client's ID (src/utils/signatureCrop.ts on the frontend) against the signature captured at contract-acceptance time, producing signature_match_score / signature_match_passed persisted on clientFaceRecognitions

httpx-based reverse-geocoding proxy that resolves the presence-capture step's captured latitude/longitude into a human-readable address; paired with @capacitor/geolocation on the frontend (PresenceCapture.tsx)
